stories.summary_en: CK Asset Holdings has suspended sales at its Yuen Long residential project Montage, days before it planned to begin marketing the development’s first homes. The developer confirmed the suspension to the South China Morning Post but declined to explain the abrupt decision, saying only that it reserved the right to pause or commence sales at any time.
stories.summary_zh: 长实集团已暂停其元朗住宅项目蒙太奇的销售，几天前该项目计划开始销售该项目的首批住宅。该开发商向《南华早报》证实了暂停销售的消息，但拒绝解释这一突然决定，仅表示保留随时暂停或开始销售的权利。

stories.title_en: Boffin's software found a possible dwarf planet - a result so rare he thought it must be a bug
stories.title_zh: 博芬的软件发现了一颗可能的矮行星——这个结果非常罕见，他认为这一定是一个错误
stories.summary_en: A scientist working on data gathered by the Rubin Observatory has found a strong candidate for our solar system’s sixth known dwarf planet. The Observatory is run by the USA’s National Science Foundation and Department of Energy, who built it on a remote hilltop in Chile and equipped it with the 3200-megapixel Legacy Survey of Space and Time (LSST) Camera, which came online in June 2026.
stories.summary_zh: 一位研究鲁宾天文台收集的数据的科学家发现了太阳系第六颗已知矮行星的有力候选者。该天文台由美国国家科学基金会和能源部运营，将其建造在智利的一个偏远山顶上，并为其配备了 3200 兆像素的遗留时空勘测 (LSST) 相机，该相机于 2026 年 6 月上线。

stories.title_en: Meteors don't just burn up. What really happens is far more violent
stories.title_zh: 流星不仅会燃烧。真正发生的事情要暴力得多
stories.summary_en: Scientists have uncovered seven surprising stages that space rocks go through as they hurtle toward Earth, revealing that melting and violent fragmentation, rather than simple evaporation, determine their fate. The discovery could help explain why meteorites scatter across the ground and how dangerous asteroids explode in Earth's atmosphere.
stories.summary_zh: 科学家们发现了太空岩石在冲向地球时经历的七个令人惊讶的阶段，揭示了它们的命运是融化和剧烈的破碎，而不是简单的蒸发。这一发现可能有助于解释为什么陨石会散布在地面上，以及危险的小行星在地球大气层中如何爆炸。

stories.title_zh: 即使您的数字看起来正常，您的血压也可能很危险
